call_points.text: Full-year ROA is guided at about 1% for FY27.

guidance.statement: Full-year ROA of about 1% for FY27, pulled forward from an earlier 'kissing distance by year-end' stance
Credit cost guidance cut to 150-160 bps from 170-180 bps
NIM guidance raised to about 5.8% from 5.75%
Cost-to-income to be taken below 70% during the year
Operating jaw of at least 500 bps to be maintained
MFI book targeted to grow 15% YoY
Aspiration to capture about 2.5% of the FCNR(B) pool

industry: Financial Services > Banks > Private Sector Bank

operating_notes.text: Bank absorbed a ₹645.59 Cr fraud expense related to deposit embezzlement at a specific branch during Q4 FY26.
Private Wealth business grew by 23% YoY to cross Rs. 57,000 crore.
Bank received ₹514.82 crore towards CGFMU claim for MFI portfolio representing ~100% of the claim submitted.
KPMG forensic report on Chandigarh branch confirmed net principal fraud amount of ₹645.59 Cr and interest of ₹30.60 Cr, already accounted for in Q4FY26.
CASA deposits crossed ₹1.5 lakh Cr with a 50.8% CASA ratio; average CA grew about 30% YoY and SA about 25% YoY.
MFI book was ₹6,700 Cr with 93% covered by CGFMU; MFI SMA 1 and 2 normalised to 0.71%.
The bank lost about ₹250 Cr last year on PSL certificate purchases and remains short of its priority-sector requirement.
FCNR(B) deposits mobilised reached ₹34,390 crore (~US$3.6 billion).

timeline.summary: IDFC FIRST Bank Limited’s senior management will discuss Q4FY26 financial results with analysts and investors on April 25, 2026, at 06:00 PM IST.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹10,552.74 Cr (+12.1% YoY), net profit ₹330.64 Cr (+11.9% YoY).
IDFC First Bank reported Q4FY26 PAT of ₹319 Cr, up 5% YoY, and normalised PAT of ₹746 Cr.
IDFC First Bank’s Board, led by Satish Gaikwad, recommended ₹0.25 final dividend (2.50% of ₹10 face value) per equity share for FY2025-26, pending shareholder and regulatory approval.
IDFC First Bank Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4-FY26 earnings call with analysts and investors on April 25, 2026, available via the bank’s website.
IDFC First Bank hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call on April 25, 2026, reporting a PAT of ₹319 Cr after a ₹646 Cr deposit fraud charge.
ICRA reaffirmed IDFC First Bank's [ICRA]AA+ (Stable) rating on ₹12,520 crore of debt instruments and withdrew ratings on ₹3,883.70 crore of redeemed NCDs.
IDFC First Bank received ₹514.82 crore under the CGFMU scheme for its microfinance portfolio claims.

IDFC First Bank disclosed the final KPMG forensic review report regarding the Chandigarh branch unauthorized activities, reaffirming the ₹646 Cr net principal impact previously accounted for in Q4FY26.
On 25 July 2026 IDFC First Bank reported Q1FY27 PAT of ₹1,075 Cr, up 132% YoY, and raised FY27 guidance to ~1% ROA, 5.8% NIM and 150-160 bps credit cost.
Crisil Ratings reaffirmed IDFC First Bank's ratings on ₹1,60,000 Cr fixed deposits, ₹8,000 Cr Tier II bonds, and ₹45,000 Cr CDs.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹11,923.29 Cr, net profit ₹1,049.17 Cr (+201.7% YoY).
IDFC First Bank reported Q2FY27 consolidated PAT of ₹1,045 Cr, up 196.5% YoY, driven by strong deposit growth and operating leverage.
Audio recording of earnings call held on October 24, 2026 made available on the bank’s website.
